validity.recommendation: Reconcile/merge P7768 into P1921 (same physical Abu Ali Island<->Berri 30-in line); decide which length is correct and keep one row.
validity.researcher_notes: STRONGEST CONCERN = duplicate. P7768 'Abu Ali-Berri Gas Pipeline' (Al Jubail->Berri Gas Plant; len 22 km, dia 30 in, cap 220 MMcf/d, StartYear 2008, FuelSource Abu Ali Island, owner Saudi Aramco) is near-identical to roster row P1921 'Abu Ali-Berri Gas Pipeline' (Abu Ali Island->Berri Gas Plant; len 44 km, dia 30 in, cap 220 MMcf/d, StartYear 2008, FuelSource Abu Ali Island, owner Saudi Aramco). They share the SAME name, diameter (30 in), capacity (220 MMcf/d), start year (2008), fuel source, endpoint, owner, AND the SAME (now-dead) ref URL (steel-network.com). The ONLY differences are length (22 vs 44 km) and P7768's segment_name 'Sub-sea Pipeline'. This reads as one physical 30-in Abu Ali Island<->Berri line double-entered (likely a route split into an onshore + sub-sea leg, or a straight relabel). The reverse-direction P1922 (dia 8) / P1923 (dia 10) 'Berri-Abu Ali' rows belong to the same corridor cluster. EXISTENCE: the corridor itself is real and independently attested - Saipem 'Berri Downstream Pipeline' scope and NS Energy / GCS Contracting describe offshore pipelines (incl. a 30-in line) connecting Aramco's Abu Ali Island processing plant to Berri/Khursaniyah/Juaymah - so this is NOT a hallucinated entity. CLASSIFICATION CAVEAT: independent sources describe the Abu Ali<->Berri downstream lines as carrying stabilized Arabian light crude oil and sour condensate (crude/condensate service), not dry transmission gas; the gas/transmission classification is not independently confirmed for this specific route and may be mis-commodity. SPEC: the 22 km / 30 in / 220 MMcf/d / 2008 figures are GEM-only - the single cited non-GEM ref (steel-network.com) now 301-redirects to a steel-industry news homepage that contains NO Abu Ali/Berri/pipeline content (link rot), and web 'confirmations' of '22 km, 30 in, 2008' trace straight back to gem.wiki. OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins cited on the wiki report country-level pipeline capacity, not this individual line. Net: real corridor, but this row is a probable duplicate of P1921 with GEM-only, uncorroborated specs and an unverified gas classification.

summary: P7768 Abu Ali-Berri: real corridor (Saipem/NS Energy confirm Abu Ali Island<->Berri 30-in line) but a probable DUPLICATE of P1921 (identical name/dia/cap/year/ref); specs (22km/30in/220 MMcf/d/2008) are GEM-only and the lone non-GEM ref is dead; gas classification unconfirmed (sources describe crude/condensate service).
